the development of a failure type-specific prognostic biomarker model for head and neck cancer.
the development of a failure site-specific predictive model that may help clinicians in selecting the optimal treatment strategy for patients with head and neck squam-ous cell carcinomas.
the development of a novel prognostic tool for head and neck cancer patients that combines information from IHC and molecular imaging with clinical data.
